description: AI lanes: each runs `claude -p` once in its own worktree and branch (lane/<name>), commits there and stops; the main session reads the result and merges. scripts/lane.py starts them; make kickoff starts `kickoff` right after the early import (KICKOFF_LANES overrides it, empty disables). Permission mode dontAsk denies every tool outside allowed_tools without asking: no web access, no remote command, no push. tool-guard (ISUCON_LANE) also refuses remote nodes, deploy, benchmarks and the operation lock.
